name: Agile Robots Agile ONE SN
summary: A compact 1.4 m research humanoid from Munich with tactile five-finger hands and preconfigured NVIDIA Isaac GR00T software, for developing robot skills in the lab.

germany.statusNote: Munich maker, but not available yet: scheduled for the beginning of 2027. No price or order route is published. Ask Agile Robots directly.

specs.label: DOF
specs.conditions: body and hands; 31 in the body

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: NVIDIA Jetson Thor plus Intel i3 N305 base module

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: RGB-D cameras on head, waist and back, wrist cameras, 3D LiDAR at the waist

specs.label: Software
specs.value: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T 1.7 and whole-body control preconfigured; URDF and USD assets

capabilities.sdk: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, URDF and USD assets
notes: A lab platform, not a site or factory robot. Skills can later move to the full-size Agile ONE.
The text does not state the drive; the product picture shows a two-legged robot.
